izmyshUnavailable: IZMYSH cannot launch yet. Its separate native qualification adapter is not implemented.
matchingBootstrapRequired: Prepare and save the matching bootstrap for {profile} ({edition}) as {saveName}, then confirm the console save before launching.
applyBeforeLaunch: Apply the host and input preferences in Developer Options before preparing or launching a session.
chooseKnownHost: Choose a host from Developer Options. The saved host is not in the pinned manifest.
unsupportedEdition: This host does not support that edition. Select full SmileBASIC 4.4.9 or choose a demo-capable host.
chooseTransport: Select manual, keyboard, composite or external-pico input.
chooseLANIPv4: Enter a usable LAN IPv4 address, or clear the override to use network discovery.
hostUnsupported: Not supported by this host. Choose a compatible host in Developer Options.
requiresVerifiedSession: Requires a verified retained-RPC session and the tool adapter.
supportedEdition: Supported edition. Use the matching bootstrap setup.
transportUnverified: Input preference only. Readiness must verify the actual transport before use.

@noSession.description: Idle shell status, not a readiness claim.

simulatedEnvironment: Simulated environment. No real hardware checks.
restartConsole: Restart the console before another attempt.
safeFailure: The operation failed before console input. Check diagnostics, then run readiness checks.
commandRejected: This action is not available in the current session state.
savePrompt: Complete the console save or overwrite prompt, then confirm here.
buildLimitations: Development shell. Console workflows are not available yet.
